entities.name: Bearer Resource Modification Reject Procedure
entities.description: Procedure executed by the network when a UE-requested bearer resource modification cannot be accepted. The MME sends a BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REJECT message with appropriate ESM cause.

entities.name: BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REJECT
entities.description: ESM message sent by the network to reject a UE-requested bearer resource modification. Contains PTI and ESM cause value.

entities.name: Procedure Transaction Identity
entities.description: Identifies the procedure transaction associated with the bearer resource modification request.

entities.name: ESM Cause
entities.description: Indicates the reason for rejecting the bearer resource modification request. Contains values like #30, #31, #32, etc.

entities.name: Traffic Flow Template
entities.description: Defines packet filters for traffic flow aggregation. Subject to semantic and syntactical error checks during modification.

entities.name: Back-off timer value
entities.description: Optional IE included in BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REJECT to control re-attempt timing.

entities.name: Re-attempt indicator
entities.description: Optional IE indicating whether UE is allowed to re-attempt modification in same/equivalent PLMN.

entities.name: T3481
entities.description: Timer associated with bearer resource modification procedure. Stopped upon receipt of BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REJECT.

entities.name: PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE
entities.description: ESM state entered by UE after receiving BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REJECT and stopping T3481.

entities.name: LIPA PDN connection or SIPTO at the local network
entities.description: Condition where bearer resource modification is for LIPA or SIPTO PDN connection, leading to rejection with cause #60.

entities.name: Local deactivation of EPS bearer context
entities.description: UE behavior when ESM cause #43 is received: locally deactivates EPS bearer context without ESM signaling.

relations.description: The procedure involves sending the BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REJECT message.
The message contains the Procedure Transaction Identity IE.
The message contains the ESM Cause IE indicating rejection reason.
The message may optionally contain the Back-off timer value IE.
The message may optionally contain the Re-attempt indicator IE.
If modification is for LIPA/SIPTO PDN connection, ESM cause #60 is used.
Upon receipt of the message, UE stops timer T3481.
UE enters PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE state after receiving the message.
If ESM cause is #43, UE locally deactivates EPS bearer context without signaling.
TFT semantic/syntactical errors lead to specific ESM cause values (#41, #42, #44, #45).
